notes.title: Shift 2 Unleashed Update Released
notes.notes: An update for Shift 2 Unleashed has been released. This update includes the free Shift 2 Unleashed DLC Pack.

notes.title: New Release - Shift 2 Unleashed
notes.notes:
Shift 2 Unleashed is now available on Steam in North America and will become available world-wide very soon (please see the Crysis 2 store page for release times).

SHIFT 2 UNLEASHED delivers all the violence, energy and excitement of race day in a groundbreaking authentic racing experience with an all-new rendering engine and graphics overhaul, innovative helmet camera, night racing, and authentic degradation of tracks and cars.

Connects with friends and competitors to race head-to-head and compare player statistic match-ups!
